messages.subject: [rkward-users] 'rk.show.question' is deprecated.
messages.body_plain:
Hello,
sorry for late reply. I compiled Git snapshot (I kept version number) at 
<https://build.opensuse.org/package/show/home:vojtaeus/rkward> and I still get 
the "'rk.show.question' is deprecated." warning... :-( I hope I haven't done 
anything wrong, I just cloned <https://invent.kde.org/education/rkward>
Few notes from compilation:
1) README.translations references for fetching translations usage of "scripts/
import_translations.py" or "git://anongit.kde.org/scratch/tfry/rkward-po-
export", but as they are at <https://invent.kde.org/tfry/rkward-po-export>, 
both ways fail.
2) openSUSE Rpmlint complains about:
W: gzipped-svg-icon /usr/share/icons/hicolor/scalable/apps/rkward.svgz
Not all desktop environments that support SVG icons support them gzipped 
(.svgz). Install the icon as plain uncompressed SVG.
W: files-duplicate /usr/share/rkward/data/multi_input.js /usr/share/rkward/
data/level_select.js (the files are indeed identical)
I also removed patch <https://build.opensuse.org/package/view_file/
devel:languages:R:released/rkward/patch-fix-crash-ggplot2.diff?expand=1> as it 
should be already unneeded.
